name: JAKO
note: German sportswear manufacturer from Mulfingen; kit supplier (Ausrüster) to VfB Stuttgart since the 2019/20 season, making the current 2026/27 home shirt. Also dresses other clubs such as Al-Ettifaq.
verdict: JAKO AG is a privately held German family sportswear company founded by Rudi Sprügel in 1989 and run by the second generation of the founding family; the register names Sturm Beteiligungs-GmbH & Co. KG as shareholder. It is a kit maker with ownership held inside one family and no state or conflicting club interests, so it is rated none.
